name: Nom Nom Edible Co | 200mg Gummies | Blood Orange Peach Sleep (4:1 THC:CBN)
description: Introducing "Nom Nom Edible Co's" newest addition to your bedtime routine: our 200mg THC sleep edible. Infused with calming passionflower and flavored with the delicious blend of blood orange and peach, each bite is a delightful journey to dreamland. With a touch of CBN, this edible gently lulls you into a state of relaxation, promoting restful sleep and rejuvenation. Say goodbye to tossing and turning, and hello to nights filled with tranquil slumber, courtesy of Nom Nom Edible Co.
